behaviors.description: Update a partial installation with omitted, single and repeated subpath options.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent A/B query runtime commits with bin and subset-control payloads; each variant starts with only bin from A.
behaviors.expected: Ordinary update to B retains the original subset; explicit options select the new subset or both payloads; an explicit-commit update back to A without subpath options preserves the selection.

mappings.rationale: Exact independent B commits and public deployment payloads distinguish ordinary retention from explicit subset replacement and expansion.

surface_assertions.rationale: Explicit single and repeated subpaths alter which payloads are deployed, unlike omission which preserves the initial subset.
